text:
alex.chang: Quick sync — we're onboarding two new orgs (EU-prod + US-staging) and need cross-cloud account setup + quota bumps. Primary ask: transient GPU burst capacity in eu-west1 and us-central1, and increased VPC egress for logs/backup flows.

maria.k: ETA for when they need capacity? we should align with billing and tagging before quota requests.

alex.chang: They want capacity for a smoke run next week (Wed). Minimum: 8x A10G equivalent per region for 48h. Longer-term: 24x reserved for dedicated pools.

sanjeev: For quota requests we need: project IDs, org IDs, billing account, and tag policy. Do we have the billing account number?

alex.chang: Yes — billing acct: 0123-4567-8901. Org IDs: org-eu-001, org-us-002. Projects: eu-prod-smoke, us-staging-smoke.

julia.ops: Adding checklist I used last time, paste below. Use it for the support ticket to cloud providers.

julia.ops: ```
- Confirm org+project links to billing account
- Set up IAM roles: infra-admin + quota-requester (group: infra-ops@redwood.com)
- Tagging: cost-center:redwood-inference, team:infra, env:staging/prod
- Request GPU quota increase (specify machine types & region)
- Request VPC egress increase (bytes/sec + concurrent flows)
- Request soft quota for burst (48h) with justification and expected start/end times
- Ask for expedite + priority support case
```

maria.k: For the cloud request body, recommend including perf justification and exact machine family. e.g., "8x nvidia-a10g per region for 48h starting 2023-06-07T08:00Z. Workload: model inference smoke (throughput test), will revert to reserved pool after run."

sanjeev: Also include network details so net team can pre-approve firewall/NAT: subnets, nat gateway, reserved external IPs. If they need VPC peering or shared VPC, call that out.

alex.chang: Network details: eu-prod-subnet (10.10.0.0/18), us-staging-subnet (10.20.0.0/18). NAT: shared-nat-eu, shared-nat-us. Need egress increased to 4Gbps across both for backup + docker pulls.

infra-bot: @here New quota request template created: https://redwood-internal/infra/quota-requests. Use "cross-cloud-burst" tag to route to cloud ops.

maria.k: We should also attach cost estimate to the ticket. Rough calc: 8 A10G * 48h * $0.90/hr =~ $345 per region (on-demand) + egress charges. Add buffer.

sanjeev: I'll draft the support case for GCP and AWS. For GCP we'll use console "Quotas" -> "Edit Quotas" flow and attach CSV with project/org details. For AWS we'll open a support case including region, desired vCPU / instance counts, and ENI limits.

julia.ops: Don't forget IAM: grant service account iam.serviceAccountUser to the infra CI principal so it can create instances in those projects. Also create a temporary role binding for the smoke window and revoke after.

alex.chang: Drafted ticket text (please review):

alex.chang: ```
Project: projects/eu-prod-smoke (org-eu-001)
Billing: 0123-4567-8901
Request: Increase GPU quota to allow 8x nvidia-a10g (or equivalent) for 2023-06-07T08:00Z to 2023-06-09T08:00Z.
Reason: Short smoke + throughput test for new inference rollout. We'll use reserved pool afterward. Attached: network CIDRs, service account approvals, cost estimate, tagging policy.
Expedite request: Yes — start date fixed.
```

maria.k: LGTM. Add contact: alex.chang@redwood.com + pager for oncall.

sanjeev: For AWS region parity, request p4d or g5? we should be explicit: request g5.12xlarge or p4dn.24xlarge equivalence depending on availability. Include fallback to lower family if unavailable with notice to ops.

alex.chang: Added fallback clause. Also asked cloud provider to reserve ephemeral external IPs and a /27 for outbound NAT if possible.

julia.ops: One more: ask for quota increase to include regional GPU inventory view so they can confirm capacity on approve. Saves back-and-forth.

alex.chang: Good call. I'll attach logs of expected instance launch schedule and an ops runbook for cleanup (terminate instances, revoke role bindings, and tag resources with "burst=eu-prod-2023-06-smoke").

maria.k: Who's owning the support case?

sanjeev: I'll own GCP. @julia.ops take AWS?

julia.ops: Yep, taking AWS. I'll open case and link to GCP ticket.

infra-bot: Support cases created: GCP#12345678 (owner: sanjeev), AWS#87654321 (owner: julia.ops). Estimated SLA: 24-48h.

alex.chang: Thanks all. Action items:
- sanjeev: file GCP quota edit + attach CSV + contact support (due: today EOD)
- julia.ops: file AWS support case + request ENI/vCPU + tag policy (due: today EOD)
- maria.k: finalize cost estimate and attach to tickets (due: EOD)
- alex.chang: prepare runbook and IAM revocation play (due: tomorrow morning)

maria.k: I'll put the cost estimate in the ticket now.

sanjeev: Filed GCP case GCP#12345678, attached CSV and network CIDRs. Marking as high priority.

julia.ops: Filed AWS case AWS#87654321, requested g5 equivalence and ENI increases. Asked for expedited review.

alex.chang: Great. Once approved, we need to coordinate capacity warm-up 2h before start. I'll ping infra-oncall. :thumbsup:

julia.ops: Reminder: post-mortem template: record actual launch counts, any throttles, tagging gaps, and billing delta.

alex.chang: Will do. Closing thread once both tickets are green.

maria.k: :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Ticket status update: GCP#12345678 -> Approved (provisioned 8 A10G in eu-west1 for 48h). AWS#87654321 -> Pending availability check.

alex.chang: Thanks team — continuing in the incident channel for run coordination.
